# Draft an architecture decision record

Read `docs/decisions/template.md` and the existing files in `docs/decisions/`. Draft the next unused, zero-padded ADR number with a concise kebab-case name. Keep the decision focused on a real choice between options, use the template's sections, and link related project docs with relative links. Don't rewrite an accepted ADR; add a new record and update its status only when it replaces an earlier decision.
